title: CargoWise Operations Co-ordinator
description:
Location: Remote WFH / Hybrid

Work Hours: Australian business hours



About the Role



We are a growing international freight forwarding company specialising in sea freight, air freight, customs brokerage, and transport solutions.



We are looking for an experienced CargoWise Operations Co-ordinator to support our expanding freight forwarding operations. The ideal candidate will already understand international freight and logistics and be highly experienced using CargoWise in a day-to-day operational environment.



High attention to detail is essential, as you will be supporting freight administration, updating systems, managing operational tasks, and ensuring information is accurate and up to date. You will work closely with our team, follow structured processes, and help contribute to smooth day-to-day operations.



We are looking for someone who is reliable, disciplined, proactive, and takes pride in delivering high-quality work as part of a supportive and professional team.



Key Responsibilities

• Register and create shipments within CargoWise.

• Create and manage consolidations (consols) for sea and air freight shipments.

• Create and manage transport jobs and customs brokerage jobs.

• Upload, manage, and eDoc shipping documentation within CargoWise.

• Monitor and track shipments from origin through to delivery.

• Update shipment milestones and maintain accurate job records.

• Process supplier invoices and post charges accurately within CargoWise.

• Assist with arrival notices, pre-alerts, and shipment status updates.

• Ensure all operational data is entered accurately and in a timely manner.

• Support the operations team with administrative and freight forwarding tasks.



Essential Requirements

• Experience working in a freight forwarding company.

• Strong hands-on experience / working knowledge of CargoWise One (CW1) is mandatory.

• Experience creating and managing sea freight and/or air freight shipments.

• Experience with customs brokerage and transport job creation.

• Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.

• Excellent written English communication skills.

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.



Understanding of freight forwarding documentation, including:

o Bills of Lading

o Commercial Invoices

o Packing Lists

o Arrival Notices

o Delivery Orders



Skills Required

• Strong computer literacy and confidence using multiple systems

• High level organisational and time management skills

• Ability to prioritise work and meet deadlines

• Reliable, disciplined, and proactive work ethic

• High attention to detail and data accuracy in system work

• Ability to work effectively with international teams



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Australian freight forwarding operations.

• Knowledge of customs and transport processes.

• Experience posting invoices and managing shipment financials in CargoWise.

• Experience working with overseas agents and shipping lines.

• Experience with End to End international shipping operations (imports & exports)



Benefits:

• Remote WFH & Hybrid available

• Day shift working 8:30am – 5:30pm Monday to Friday Australian business hours 

• No weekend work

• Holiday & sick leave

• Australian national public holidays

• All government mandated benefits Pagibig, SSS & Phil Health and HMO

• 13th Month pay

title: AP Clerk
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented and reliable Accounts Payable Clerks to join a fast-paced US-based healthcare operations team. In this role, you will be responsible for processing and managing vendor payments across multiple entities, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with internal policies. This is a great opportunity for someone with a solid AP background who thrives in a structured, high-volume environment.

 

What You'll Do

• Process and review vendor invoices for accuracy, proper coding, and authorization across multiple healthcare entities.

• Schedule and process payments via ACH, check, and credit card in accordance with payment terms and company policy.

• Perform credit card reconciliation, matching transactions to receipts and statements on a regular basis.

• Maintain and update the accounts payable ledger, ensuring all entries are accurate and up to date.

• Communicate with vendors to resolve discrepancies, missing invoices, or payment inquiries in a timely manner.

• Assist in month-end closing activities including AP aging reports and account reconciliations.

• Ensure all payments are processed before due dates to avoid late fees or penalties.

• Maintain organized and accurate filing of all AP documentation, both digital and physical.

• Collaborate with the Treasury and Finance teams to ensure proper cash flow management.

• Adhere to internal AP policies and procedures, including the payment threshold authorization guidelines.

 

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

• At least 1-3 years of experience in Accounts Payable or a related finance/accounting role.

• Hands-on experience with credit card reconciliation, this is a key requirement for this role.

• Experience working with multiple entities or business units simultaneously.

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting or AP software (e.g., QuickBooks, 
, Ramp, or similar platforms).

• Excellent attention to detail and high level of accuracy in data entry and financial processing.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

• Good communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

• Ability to work independently and proactively in a remote setting.

• Must have a reliable and stable internet connection, a personal computer or laptop, and an extra monitor to work efficiently in a remote setup.

 

Preferred Qualifications

• Background or experience in healthcare is a plus.

• Familiarity with US-based AP processes, payment methods (ACH, wire transfers, checks), and vendor management.

• Experience with multi-entity or multi-facility accounting environments.

 

What to Expect

Work Environment

• This is a fully remote position. You will be working with a US-based healthcare operations team across multiple facilities and entities.

• You will collaborate closely with the AP team, Treasury, and Finance departments on a daily basis.

• Your schedule will be 9:30 AM – 6:00 PM PST, Monday through Friday - reliability and punctuality are essential.

 

Volume & Pace

• This is a high-volume AP environment. You can expect to process a large number of invoices and transactions on a daily basis.

• You will be managing payments for multiple entities simultaneously, so strong multitasking and prioritization skills are a must.

 

Compensation & Benefits

• Competitive entry-level monthly salary with the possibility of a yearly salary increase based on performance.

• Stable, long-term remote work opportunity with a growing US-based healthcare organization.

• Supportive onboarding process through Agentic Staffing LLC, with ongoing support throughout your placement.

title: Sales / Appointment-Setting VA (Givora)
description:
About Givora



Givora is an Australian hyperlocal fundraising service for community charities. We take fundraising and storytelling off a charity's plate — always-on impact videos plus a campaign each quarter (a raffle, an auction, a seasonal appeal) — for a fixed monthly fee, never a cut of what's raised. The charity stays the registered operator; we're the engine behind them. Our line: Charities empower people. We empower charities.



The Role



Keep the founder's calendar full of booked, qualified meetings with local charities — by running our outreach engine end to end, so the founder only has to show up and close.



You own everything up to the booked meeting. You will not be cold-calling on the phone or producing video — your job is research, personalised written/video outreach, follow-up, partner admin, and scheduling.



What You'll Do



Outbound (the core of the role)

- Build target lists from our Notion database and the public ACNC charity register — the best 1–3 charities per cause category in each target area.

- Research each charity enough to personalise the approach (what they do, who the decision-maker is, their contact details).

- Run our outreach sequence 
 + LinkedIn + a short personalised video), follow up persistently but politely, and book interested charities into the founder's calendar.



Partners

- Prospect and contact "trust hubs" (peak bodies, councils, NFP-focused accountants, service clubs), send them our prospectus, and schedule introduction calls for the founder.



Inbound

- Schedule and post content we provide, monitor our website enquiry form and inboxes, and respond to/qualify every enquiry within one business day.



Pipeline & Reporting

- Keep our Notion pipeline immaculate (every contact, stage and note logged).

- Prepare a short brief before each booked meeting.

- Send a weekly numbers report and propose next week's target areas.



Must-Have Skills

- Excellent written English (this is a writing-heavy role).

- Prior experience as an SDR, appointment-setter, or sales/outreach VA.

- Comfortable with CRMs / Notion,
, LinkedIn, and scheduling tools.

- Highly organised, self-managing, and reliable; able to work to targets with light supervision.

- Stable internet and some overlap with Australian Eastern business hours for scheduling.



Nice to Have

- Experience with an
-sequencing tool (Instantly, Lemlist) and with Loom or similar.

- Familiarity with the nonprofit/charity sector and/or the Australian market.



Tools You'll Use

Notion · Calendly (or 
) · Gmail / an
 sequencer · LinkedIn · Loom · a social scheduler (Buffer/Metricool).



Hours & Arrangement

Part-time to start, ~20 hours/week, with room to grow to full-time as volume increases. Remote.



Pay

- Base: USD $8–12/hour (intermediate sales-VA range).

- Performance bonus: USD $20–40 for every qualified meeting that goes ahead.

- 13th-month pay included, in line with local norms.



How We Work Together

The founder handles the meetings, the pitch, the relationships and the close — and records a monthly batch of content. You handle everything else and run a 30-minute pipeline check-in with the founder each week. A detailed playbook with all templates and SOPs is provided on day one.



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

- The pipeline is clean and current in Notion.

- A steady, growing number of qualified meetings booked per week.

- Inbound enquiries answered within one business day, every time.



To Apply

1. Tell us briefly about your outreach/appointment-setting experience and the tools you've used.

2. Share any reply-rate or meetings-booked numbers you're proud of.

3. Short task: write a 120-word cold outreach
 to a fictional local food-relief charity, inviting them to a call. We're assessing your written English, warmth, and ability to personalise. (Don't worry about getting our facts perfect — we want to see your writing.)

 ads with sharp pacing, clean cuts, and strong hooks within the first 3 seconds. You’ll generate and sync AI voiceovers using ElevenLabs, matching tone, emotion, and rhythm to the visuals. Expect ongoing work producing multiple ad variations, cutdowns, and retargeting versions every week.



What You’ll Do

Edit short-form performance ads specifically for Meta 
 & Instagram), with TikTok as a plus.

Turn raw footage, stock/b-roll, and AI assets into polished, high-converting ad creatives.

Generate and sync AI voiceovers in ElevenLabs, choosing the right voice, emotion, and pacing for each script.

Add captions/subtitles, hooks, transitions, sound effects, and optimized pacing for paid social.

Produce multiple variations, cutdowns, and retargeting versions based on performance and feedback.

Follow creative briefs and direction closely while maintaining consistent quality and speed.



Required Skills & Experience

This is a performance-editing role, not a generic video editor position.

You must:

Have proven experience editing e-commerce ads specifically for Meta/Facebook (not just organic or long-form content).

Be confident with clipping, pacing, and timing for paid social ads — especially strong hooks within the first 3 seconds and high retention through the first 30 seconds.

Have hands-on experience with ElevenLabs for AI voiceover generation (voice selection, emotion tuning, and clean audio output).

Be highly proficient in CapCut Pro, Premiere Pro, or After Effects.

Be comfortable with captions/subtitles, sound design, b-roll layering, and basic motion graphics.

Have a strong understanding of what actually performs inside Meta Ads Manager (creatives, hooks, formats that drive results).

Have experience with short-form ad formats: UGC-style ads, voiceover ads, and product/demo ads.

Be able to meet daily deadlines, work independently, and communicate clearly in English.

Reliable internet, a capable editing setup, and the ability to handle ongoing work are non-negotiable.



Application Requirements (Strict)

To be considered, your proposal must include all of the following:

Direct links to previous
/Meta ads you have personally edited (not team projects, not generic reels).

Names of past clients or brands you’ve worked with, and case studies or results if available.

A short note on your editing workflow:

Software you use

How you approach hooks, pacing, and retention

How you integrate ElevenLabs voiceovers into your edits

Applications without work samples or without clear
/Meta ad experience will be rejected immediately. Do not apply if you are not specialized in paid social ad editing.



Trial Period (Paid)

Before moving to full-time, there will be a paid 2-week trial to evaluate:

Skill level and creative quality

Speed and consistency

Ability to follow directions and implement feedback

Trial terms:

Pay during trial: 10 USD per completed video/ad

Training, examples, and feedback will be provided

Only candidates who pass the trial will be considered for the full-time role



Full-Time Role Details (After Trial)

Weekends off (Saturday & Sunday)

Scripts are sent every weekday

Videos must be completed and delivered before the following day

Task-based work (no fixed hours, but daily deliverables are required)

Payment: 212 USD per week, paid every Sunday

Performance bonus: 150 USD for any “winning ad” that performs well in paid campaigns

This is a long-term, stable role for the right editor.



Responsibilities

Edit short-form voiceover ads for Meta 
 & Instagram), with TikTok as a plus.

Sync visuals tightly to ElevenLabs-generated voiceovers (access will be provided).

Use provided b-roll, product assets, and custom b-roll where needed.

Add attention-grabbing hooks, captions, transitions, and sound design optimized for paid social.

Follow creative briefs, brand guidelines, and iterative feedback closely.

Maintain consistent quality while hitting fast turnarounds.



Who This Role Is For

This role is for someone who:

Edits for performance and conversions first, not just aesthetics.

Understands hooks, pacing, and retention in a paid social context.

Wants a stable, long-term position with predictable weekly work.

Is motivated by performance-based bonuses and “winning ads.”

Can grow with the brand and contribute ideas to improve creatives over time

title: FP&A Analyst
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented FP&A Analyst to support finance operations within a fast-paced, data-driven, and high-performance environment.



The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in FP&A functions including budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, management reporting, and variance analysis, combined with exposure to General Ledger (GL) accounting processes and strong technical/data skills such as SQL and reporting tools.



This role is ideal for finance professionals who are comfortable working cross-functionally, supporting leadership teams, analyzing large datasets, and translating financial data into actionable business insights.



Who This Role Is For



We are looking for professionals who thrive in:

• Fast-paced finance and shared services environments

• Data-driven and analytical organizations

• Cross-functional business teams

• Strategic finance and operational finance roles

• High-growth and process-oriented environments

• Roles requiring ownership, accountability, and problem-solving



Role Overview



The FP&A Analyst will support key finance and analytical functions including:

• Budgeting and forecasting

• Financial modeling and analysis

• Variance and trend analysis

• KPI and business performance reporting

• GL analysis and topside journal support

• Financial planning and operational finance support

• Executive and management reporting

• Data extraction and reporting analysis



Depending on business needs, the role may also support multi-entity reporting structures, operational finance initiatives, systems/process improvement, and ad hoc strategic analysis.



Key Responsibilities



Financial Planning & Forecasting

• Assist in preparing budgets, forecasts, and financial plans

• Support monthly, quarterly, and annual forecasting cycles

• Analyze actuals versus budget and forecast results

• Assist in operational, headcount, and expense planning

• Support scenario planning and forecasting model improvements



Financial Analysis & GL Support

• Perform variance, trend, profitability, and financial performance analysis

• Support GL analysis including topside entries, accrual review, and reconciliations

• Assist in month-end reporting and financial review processes

• Prepare executive-ready financial reports, dashboards, and management presentations

• Support KPI tracking and business performance reporting



Data Analytics & Reporting

• Utilize SQL for data extraction, manipulation, and reporting analysis

• Analyze large datasets and provide actionable insights

• Assist in building and improving dashboards and reporting tools

• Support finance reporting automation and process improvements

• Work with ERP and reporting systems to ensure data accuracy and reporting efficiency



Business Partnership & Cross-Functional Support

• Partner closely with Accounting, Operations, HR, and leadership teams

• Support strategic decision-making through financial analysis and reporting

• Assist business units with budgeting and reporting requirements

• Support ad hoc analysis, projects, and process improvement initiatives



Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field

• Minimum 3+ years of FP&A, financial analysis, corporate finance, or related finance experience

• Strong experience in budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis

• Exposure to GL accounting processes, reconciliations, accruals, or month-end close

• Hands-on SQL experience for data extraction and reporting analysis

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills

• Experience with ERP systems, finance systems, and reporting tools

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and financial modeling abilities

• Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to work independently and manage deadlines effectively



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting US-based companies or offshore/shared services environments

• Experience in SaaS, technology, BPO, or high-growth environments

• Exposure to multi-entity finance operations

• Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Power Query, VBA, or similar reporting/analytics tools

• Experience with Workday Adaptive, Hyperion, SAP BPC, or similar FP&A systems is highly preferred

• CPA, CFA, MBA, or equivalent certifications are an advantage

• Experience working cross-functionally with leadership teams is preferred



Application Instructions



To be considered for this position, please submit the following:

• Your application letter

• Unrestricted link to your updated resume/CV



Subject Line:

FPAA – YOUR FULL NAME



Only applicants who meet the required qualifications will be contacted.

We're looking for someone who can draw by hand as a baseline indicator for art fundamentals; whose work shows strong character taste — expression, gesture, emotional acting, aesthetic charm, and animation or storytelling instincts. AI tool experience is a plus, not a requirement. We can train the AI pipeline relatively quickly, but the artistic talent and execution ceiling we're looking for is not something we can teach. Therefore,



**We're especially interested in people who've built and sustained their own creative work — a channel, a webcomic, indie projects, a personal art practice, or deployed content for someone else with sustained self-directed shipping and creative exploration and ownership. If your background is more traditional (studio, agency, client work), that's fine too — we'll evaluate on the work itself.**



AI has collapsed the creative space into taste, artistic eye, experimentation, and speed of execution. So we're looking for execution discipline — you finish work, you iterate cleanly, you ship completed videos autonomously under shifting artistic demand, and you adapt quickly across different styles and mediums.



What you'll do



Steering, selecting, rejecting, refining, and sequencing AI-generated visuals so they match our shifting style demands, emotional tone, and character identity.



- Visual-audio judgment and strict curation of AI output

- Refine expressive character stills using AI tools, reference pools

- Generate motion video from curated stills using AI video tools (Seedance2, Kling — training provided)

- Time clips of varying styles to narration, and deliver finished 20–60 second character-led videos

- Curate ElevenLabs voiceover and attitude (guidance provided)

- Sequence and time motion clips against narration

- Keep recurring characters consistent across many pieces

- Help build reference systems and visual judgment language over time

- Document what worked, what failed, and why — so the system improves



Style direction

Character work with high emotional expressiveness — diverse emotional and stylistic grammar from shoujo/josei to shonen/seinen and virality-native illustrated character storytelling. Work should feel alive and artist-directed, not randomly generated. You can play across emotional registers — dramatic, comedic, melancholic, playful, action-driven.



We provide SOPs on content format and scripting, but having your own working sense of what makes content land + general virality sense, will make the process smoother.



You might be a fit if you

- Have visual substrate in character work — illustration, comics, animation, storyboards, VTuber assets, visual novels, AI character work, or another medium where expression and character consistency matter

- Can diagnose why a character feels off

- Sustain self-directed creative output

- Are curious about AI image and motion tools, even if you haven't used them extensively yet

- Can time visual beats to narration rhythm

- Communicate clearly and work well async



AI-assisted portfolios are welcome — we'll evaluate your execution.



Compensation

$800–$1,100 USD/month full-time depending on portfolio and trial performance. Higher long-term compensation available for candidates with autonomous judgment as we expand our worldbuilding and brand. We're looking for a long-term creative partner.



Trial period prior to confirmed engagement. Tool access and AI tool credits provided.



How to apply

Send:



Portfolio link — your best work. Ideally work you've deployed into your own channels or someone else's, or any creative project you've sustained over time, showcasing self-directed creative ownership.



Character or emotional pieces, showcasing your expressive range, charming aesthetic execution, etc.

Motion or sequence sample if available (animatic, short edit, Live2D/VTuber motion, AI motion, storyboard sequence, AE edits, etc)



To confirm you've read the full posting, include the phrase "character-first" in your application

Use at least 7 apply points.



Shortlisted candidates move into a paid two-week trial that may convert to a confirmed monthly retainer.

Salary: $400–$600/month (negotiable based on experience)



Hours: Full-Time (40 hours/week, Monday–Friday)



Job Description:



We are a fast-growing women's fashion e-commerce company operating multiple brands in the US and UK markets. We are looking for a talented Fashion Creative Designer who lives and breathes fashion advertising.

This is NOT a general graphic design role. We need someone who understands what makes a fashion ad SELL — the scroll-stopping hooks, the visual storytelling, the urgency, the lifestyle angle, and the conversion-focused design that turns viewers into buyers.

What You'll Do:



Create high-converting video ads and static image ads for
/Meta, Instagram, TikTok, Google, and Pinterest

Design scroll-stopping ad creatives specifically for women's fashion (dresses, tops, shoes, accessories)

Edit and produce short-form video ads (15–30 seconds) using product footage, AI-generated content, and lifestyle imagery

Create UGC-style content, product showcases, before/after styling videos, and trend-based content

A/B test different creative angles, hooks, and formats

Study competitor ads (Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center) and create our own versions

Produce carousel ads, collection ads, and dynamic product ads

Work closely with our media buyer to align creatives with campaign strategy

Deliver 15–20 new creatives per week across multiple brands



Must-Have Skills:



Proven experience creating fashion ad creatives that actually convert (show us your work)

Strong understanding of what works in paid fashion advertising (hooks, angles, CTAs)

Proficiency in video editing: CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects

Proficiency in image design: Canva Pro, Photoshop, or Figma

Experience with AI image generation tools (Krea AI, Midjourney, Leonardo, or similar)

Understanding of Meta/Facebook ad formats and specifications

Eye for fashion aesthetics, trends, and styling

Ability to produce content quickly without sacrificing quality

Strong English skills for ad copy and text overlays



Nice to Have:



Experience working with fashion e-commerce or dropshipping brands

Knowledge of TikTok ad creative best practices

Experience with Google Shopping and Performance Max ad formats

Understanding of ROAS, CTR, and how creatives impact ad performance

Experience creating UGC-style content



What We Provide:



Access to all tools and software (Canva Pro, AI tools, stock footage)

Product images and store access

Clear creative briefs and brand guidelines

Weekly feedback on creative performance data (what's working, what's not)

Long-term position with growth potential — opportunity to lead a creative team

title: Operations & Founder Support VA – Co-Living + Systems + SaaS
description:
TotalStaySolution and Swedish House operate a growing co-living property management business and a SaaS-based mentorship ecosystem built on GoHighLevel for real estate investor/operators. This is not a generic customer service position — it is a right-hand support role designed to help the Co-Founder stay focused, organized, and operationally supported across both brands.



Two part-time VAs will work together to provide 7-day coverage — one VA covers Monday–Friday, the other covers Thursday–Monday. The primary focus is helping the Co-Founder translate moving parts into consistent execution: inbox control, follow-up, documentation, CRM hygiene, communication support, and day-to-day operational continuity.

What You'll Own:



Support the Co-Founder with daily operational follow-through across both brands

Triage inboxes, messages, and task flow so important items do not get lost

Turn voice notes, chat threads, rough drafts, and messy ideas into clean SOPs, templates, summaries, and next steps

Maintain CRM hygiene and workflow accuracy inside GoHighLevel

Coordinate maintenance and operational follow-up including vendor communication, request tracking, and status updates

Monitor member/tenant/vendor communications across chat,
, and phone with calm, structured responses

Track payments, late balances, and basic ledger updates with accuracy

Support calendar coordination, reminders, and administrative follow-through for the Co-Founder

Assist with light content and marketing support across Instagram,
, YouTube, LinkedIn, and Canva

Keep internal documents, knowledge bases, and recurring workflows organized and up to date



You're a Strong Fit If You:



Write and speak clear, calm English (C1 level or better) — no slang, no emotional reactivity

Are naturally organized and strong at follow-up

Can take rough draft instructions and turn them into clear action

Ask clarifying questions instead of guessing

Are comfortable supporting a neurodivergent, visionary co-founder who may think quickly, speak in shorthand, and need help structuring next steps

Stay steady under pressure and do not become emotionally reactive

Enjoy improving systems, not just completing tasks

Can handle confidential information related to housing, payments, and sensitive member situations with maturity and discretion

Are willing to sign an NDA and non-compete



Preferred Background (Not Required):

Operations or executive assistant support, property management, co-living or hospitality, SaaS support or CRM administration, real estate operations, or admin support for a founder or small fast-moving company



Nice to Have:

GoHighLevel experience

Basic bookkeeping comfort

Experience documenting SOPs and workflows

Ability to summarize long documents into concise briefs

Comfort supporting U.S.-based operations across time zones



Tools You'll Use:

Google Workspace, GoHighLevel, Canva / Affinity, Instagram /
 / YouTube / LinkedIn



Wage/Salary: $500/month per VA

Desired Hours/Week: 20

Business Name: TotalStaySolution / Swedish House



To apply, send your resume and a 2–3 minute intro video explaining why this role is a strong fit for you, plus a short note on any experience supporting a founder, operator, or fast-moving team. In the subject line write: "ERRIN is the COOLEST!"

title: Killer Shopify Manager
description:
We’re looking for a young gun who knows Shopify inside and out. And please, read the section at the bottom of this page, about who we DON'T want.



Someone sharp. Fast. Hungry. Someone who actually likes building stores, fixing problems, improving pages, making things convert better, and learning how real growth works inside a fast-moving agency.



You need to be genuinely good at Shopify.

That part matters most.



We want someone who:



knows their way around Shopify day to day, and code

can handle pages, apps, theme edits, store setup, and general backend management

has energy

wants to learn more

wants to work with other ambitious young people

wants to level up hard



This is for someone who wants more than a basic job.

You’ll work inside The Cultivator with a young team, get exposed to serious growth work, build real skills, and be around people chasing big things.



The kind of person we want probably sees themselves doing very well in life. Nice cars. Big future. Real 
ntum.

But right now, they’re ready to earn it.



If you’re switched on, confident with Shopify, and keen to grow with a killer agency, we want to hear from you.



Who We’re Not Looking For:



We’re not looking for someone who’s been sitting in the industry for years and has picked up slow habits, stale thinking, or a big ego from doing the same thing too long.



We’re also not looking for someone whose whole skillset starts and ends with Canva. That’s not enough here. This role needs someone who actually understands Shopify and can work effectively within a store.



And we’re definitely not looking for low-energy people. If you’re flat, slow to move, hard to motivate, or just want to coast, this won’t be the place for you.



We want someone fresh, switched on, sharp, and ready to get after it.



Apply Now:

Please submit your CV here so we can review it. If you are passionate and dedicated, we would love to work with you asap: 



Looking forward to meeting you.

title: DM Appointment Setter
description:
We run a fast-growing results-driven online fitness coaching company helping busy Asian men lose stubborn belly fat, build lean muscle, and stay in shape without cutting out the cultural foods they love.



Our brand and client base is growing fast and we have TOO MANY leads to handle. As a result, we are rapidly expanding our team and looking for a high-performance DM setter who knows how to turn conversations into booked calls so we can help even more people!



If you thrive in a results-driven environment and want uncapped earning potential, keep reading.



Compensation:



- Full-time: 40–50 hours per week

- Pay: $650 USD per month

- Commission: 3-5% of cash collected from every client you book who enrolls

- Expected Earnings: $800–$1,200+ per month



**Top performers earn significantly more. This is a performance-based role. Your income scales with your output.



What You’ll Be Responsible For:



- Initiating conversations with new followers, story viewers, and engaged prospects

- Reaching out to warm and targeted outbound leads daily

- Using our scripts + frameworks while making conversations feel natural and human

- Asking intelligent qualifying questions

- Moving qualified prospects into booked sales calls

- Following up consistently with warm leads

- Tracking conversations and outcomes inside our CRM

- Maintaining our brand voice and communication standards

- You will be expected to generate volume while maintaining quality.



What We’re Looking For:



- Strong written English (clear, natural, professional — no grammar mistakes)

- Quick response speed and ability to handle multiple conversations at once

- 1–3+ years of experience as a DM setter (fitness industry preferred)

- Proven history of booking qualified calls that actually show up

- Reliable laptop + fast internet

- Comfortable sending 80–100+ high-quality messages per day

- Willing to work flexible hours, including weekends when needed

- Highly coachable and able to take feedback fast

- Competitive, disciplined, and motivated by performance

- We move quickly. You must be comfortable keeping up.



Why This Is a Big Opportunity:



- Work directly with a rapidly scaling online fitness coaching company with a passion for client results and excellence across the board

- Clear SOPs, scripts, and leadership support

- Real growth path for top performers (raises + leadership opportunities)

- Paid onboarding and training

- Remote position

- Be part of a team with high standards and long-term vision

- We value excellence, accountability, and growth.



How To Apply:



Send a short message replying to this job post explaining why you want to apply



**within 24-72 hours, all eligible applicants will be invited to an interview.



Looking forward to speaking with you!

title: AI Creative Assistant for YouTube channel

title: Website Designer / WordPress Developer for English Pronunciation Coaching Business
description:
This is a one-time project, not an ongoing position. The listed salary/hours are only for the platform requirements. Please provide your fixed-price quote for the complete project when applying.



I'm looking for a website designer/developer to create a professional website for my English pronunciation coaching business.



I already own the domain and have a clear idea of what I want. The website should be designed to build trust, convert visitors into booked consultation calls, and provide a strong foundation for future SEO growth.



About the Business



I help Spanish-speaking professionals in the United States improve their English pronunciation, speaking confidence, and communication skills.



Many of my clients are engineers, healthcare professionals, researchers, and other skilled professionals who use English daily at work but want to communicate more clearly and naturally.



The primary goal of the website is to convert LinkedIn visitors into booked pronunciation assessments and consultation calls.



What I Need



Home page

About page

Services page

Testimonials page

Contact page

Calendly integration

Mobile-friendly design

Contact form

Fast loading speed

Basic on-page SEO setup

Easy for me to edit and update in the future

Ability to easily add future testimonials and case studies without developer assistance



SEO Requirements



I'm not looking for advanced SEO services at this stage, but I would like:



SEO-friendly website structure

Proper heading structure (H1, H2, H3)

Meta titles and descriptions

Image optimization

Fast page speed

Basic keyword optimization

Google Analytics setup

Google Search Console setup (if possible)



Preferred Platform



WordPress is preferred, but I'm open to recommendations.



I value conversion-focused design and user experience more than flashy visuals. The website should clearly communicate the value of my coaching program and make it easy for visitors to book a consultation.



When Applying



Please include:



Examples of websites you've built

Whether you built them yourself or worked as part of a team

What platform you recommend and why

Estimated timeline

Your fixed-price quote

A brief explanation of how you would structure the homepage to maximize conversions



Please indicate whether you can assist with hosting setup and connecting my existing domain, as I have already purchased the domain but have not yet set up hosting.



Bonus



If you have experience building websites for coaches, consultants, tutors, educators, or personal brands, please mention that in your application.

title: Virtual Assistant / Appointment Setter / Client Success Manager (CSM)
description:

Remote | Base + Commission + Bonuses

Full-Time | U.S. Construction Industry



About Us



We are a fast-growing digital marketing agency that helps U.S.-based construction businesses (landscapers, contractors, hardscapers, concrete companies, and home service providers) generate consistent, high-quality leads and turn them into booked appointments. Our systems focus on performance, communication, and long-term client success.

This position is ideal for someone who is articulate, organized, confident, and understands how to communicate professionally with American homeowners and business owners.



Role Overview



This is a dual-role position combining:



Appointment Setting for warm homeowner leads



Client Success Management for ongoing client communication and feedback



You will be responsible for ensuring leads are properly handled, appointments are booked, and clients feel supported, informed, and taken care of.

Appointment Setting



Call warm homeowner leads provided by our marketing systems



Qualify leads and book appointments for our construction clients



Follow up with leads via phone, SMS, and CRM notes



Maintain high booking rates and professional communication



Client Success Management



Call clients regularly to gather feedback on lead quality and service performance



Identify issues, concerns, or improvement opportunities



Report feedback clearly to the internal team



Ensure client satisfaction and strengthen relationships



Communication & Coordination



Act as the main communication bridge between clients and internal departments



Ensure information is accurately transferred and followed up



Keep detailed notes and updates in the CRM and tracking systems



Requirements



English level: C2 (Fluent) with a neutral accent ONLY

(Absolutely no strong accents – this role requires regular Zoom calls with U.S. clients)



Comfortable speaking confidently on Zoom with American business owners

Clean, presentable background



Stable internet connection



Clear microphone and camera



Prior experience in:



Appointment setting



Client success



Customer service



Call center or outbound dialing (preferred)



Excellent:



Communication skills



Time management



Organization



Follow-up consistency



Attention to detail



What We Offer



Base salary + commission + performance bonuses



Long-term role with room for growth



Consistent workflow and stable leads



Remote work flexibility



Opportunity to grow into senior roles inside the company



 Performance-based incentives and recognition



We are building a serious, structured company with long-term vision. If you are reliable, ambitious, and professional, this is a role where you can grow with us.



! IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS !



Applications that do NOT follow these steps will NOT be reviewed.



Start your application message with EXACTLY the following sentence:

"I read the sentence and I don’t have an accent."



After that, send a 2–3 minute video introducing yourself covering:



Your experience in appointment setting / client success



Why you believe you're a great fit for this role



Your communication style and confidence working with U.S. clients



Who This Role Is For



Professionals who speak flawless English

People who enjoy talking to clients and building relationships

High-performers who want stable income + growth

Detail-oriented individuals who care about results and client satisfaction

title: Senior Customer Service Specialist
description:
Senior Customer Service Specialist — Branded E-Commerce (UK/US Markets)



We are a fast-growing branded e-commerce company operating multiple Shopify stores across the UK, US, and other English-speaking markets. Our portfolio consists of several independent brands across different niches, and we are currently looking to hire multiple experienced Customer Service Specialists to strengthen and scale our customer service operations.



About the Role



In this position, you will be responsible for customer service operations for one or more of our brands. We will provide you with our existing knowledge base and SOPs built over several years, and we expect you to combine this with your own expertise to continuously improve performance, efficiency, and customer experience.



Your primary objective is to maintain a refund rate below 5% and minimize chargebacks as much as possible. Every interaction you handle directly impacts customer satisfaction, brand reputation, and business profitability.



You will also work closely with suppliers, logistics partners, and our dispute management team to ensure customer issues are resolved efficiently and professionally.



Top-performing agents will have the opportunity to take responsibility for multiple stores and brands as they demonstrate strong performance and reliability.

* Handle approximately 20 high-quality
 tickets per hour

* Communicate with suppliers regarding delays, product quality concerns, and fulfillment issues

* Work closely with the dispute manager on chargeback cases and required documentation

* Liaise with shipping partners and last-mile carriers to resolve delivery problems

* Train and support junior customer service agents when required

* Improve and maintain SOPs, macros, templates, and workflows

* Provide daily and weekly performance reports to management

* Identify recurring issues and provide actionable feedback to improve customer experience and operational performance



What We Are Looking For



* Minimum 2+ years of customer service experience for branded Shopify stores generating at least $100,000+ per month in revenue (required)

* Proven ability to reduce refunds and chargebacks through strong communication and process management

* Strong experience with Shopify Admin (orders, refunds, fulfillment, customer data)

* Daily experience using Reamaze, Gorgias, Zendesk, or similar support platforms

* Understanding of shipping, fulfillment, and last-mile delivery processes

* Experience working with international suppliers

* Ability to handle approximately 20 well-written tickets per hour without compromising quality

* Excellent written and spoken English (near-native level)

* Strong de-escalation and problem-solving skills

* Independent worker who takes ownership without requiring constant supervision

* Customer-focused and empathetic communication style



### Preferred Qualifications



* Experience managing customer service for multiple brands simultaneously

* Experience with stores operating in the UK and US markets

* Experience in environments processing high ticket volumes while maintaining strong customer satisfaction metrics

* Proven track record of maintaining low refund rates and minimizing chargebacks in stores generating six-figure monthly revenue



 Mindset We Value



* Solution-oriented: balances customer satisfaction with business objectives

* Data-driven: tracks KPIs and continuously seeks improvements

* Calm under pressure: handles difficult situations professionally

* Long-term thinker: understands the impact of every interaction on brand reputation

* Detail-oriented: prevents small issues from turning into refunds or chargebacks

* Proactive communicator: keeps teams informed and aligned



What We Offer



* Long-term collaboration with significant growth opportunities

* Competitive compensation based on experience

* Opportunity to grow from managing a single store to managing multiple brands

* Work with multiple fast-growing e-commerce brands across various niches

* Fully remote working environment

* Performance-based bonuses tied to refund rate and chargeback reduction

* Additional earning potential for agents who successfully manage multiple stores



Important



We are only looking for serious, long-term candidates with proven experience working for established branded e-commerce businesses. If you have only worked with beginner dropshipping stores, low-volume brands, or have no experience managing customer service for stores doing at least $100,000+ per month in revenue, this role is likely not the right fit.



Please indicate in your application whether you are interested in managing:

Agents who consistently perform at a high level will have the opportunity to take on additional brands and increase their responsibilities and compensation over time.

title: Manager, Billing & Financial Operations - Remote
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading. We're doing it with a technology-forward approach, actively developing the AI infrastructure that will make this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

The Manager, Billing & Financial Operations is the operational owner of MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions' non-CA financial transaction engine — the function that ensures every invoice goes out accurately, every payment gets applied, every vendor gets paid, and every manifest and billing record is reconciled and audit-ready.



This is a 1st-line management role for a detail-obsessed, process-driven leader who has run billing and collections teams before. You are not just doing the work — you are building the systems, the SOPs, and the team discipline that make the work run without constant supervision. You manage the specialists; you own the numbers; you report up to leadership with clean, confident data.



Key Responsibilities:

Billing Operations & Transaction Processing

• Own end-to-end billing operations — from invoice generation through delivery, dispute resolution, and closed-loop reconciliation across all MedPro and MP1 service lines

• Oversee accurate and timely processing of all financial transactions: vendor payables, service billings, manifest entries, client invoices, and payment applications

• Ensure all billing records align with service agreements, contracts, and pricing structures — identifying and correcting discrepancies before they reach the client or vendor

• Manage the billing cycle calendar: maintain a disciplined, predictable cadence for invoice runs, payment postings, and month-end closes

• Build and enforce quality controls that reduce error rates, prevent duplicate payments, and maintain clean accounts across all transaction types

ed instructions from our California team and ensuring it is accurately entered into our CRM. You will be explicitly trained on our standards and procedures ("the GraphicLab way") by our lead VA.

 and social media outreach campaigns using CRM/customer data to help us re-engage past customers and generate new leads.

Communication: Maintain clear, daily communication with the California-based Sales Team to provide end-of-shift progress reports.



 + Social Campaign Support (Slow-Season Outreach):

 campaigns (subject lines, copy, basic layout) to re-engage customers and drive quote requests.

lawless English (Written and Spoken): You must be able to write clear, professional

title: Day Trading
description:
Position: Forex Trader / Account Manager

Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Type: Part-Time / Performance-Based

Base Retainer: $300 per month

Profit Share: 10% to Trader / 90% to Account Owner

Starting Capital: $500 (scalable upon proven performance)

Drawdown Limit:Max 2–3?ily | Max 5–8% overall

Reporting: Weekly performance updates required



POSITION OVERVIEW

We are seeking a disciplined, data-driven, and consistently profitable Forex Account Manager to actively trade and manage a dedicated capital account. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of navigating the FX markets with strict risk management, emotional control, and a clearly defined trading edge.



This is a performance-based role. You trade the capital — we share the profits. Capital under management will be scaled significantly for traders who demonstrate consistent and responsible growth.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Active Trading & Market Analysis:

Analyse major and minor FX pairs and execute trades based on a verified, structured trading strategy.

Maintain consistent market engagement aligned with agreed trading windows and session coverage.



Risk Management

Strictly adhere to a maximum daily drawdown of 2–3% and an overall account drawdown limit of 5–8%.

Preserve capital as the primary operational mandate — profit generation is secondary to drawdown control.

Avoid over-leveraging, martingale, grid strategies, and revenge trading in all circumstances.



Consistency & Performance

Deliver steady, scalable account growth with minimal volatility.

Execute only within pre-agreed risk parameters, regardless of market conditions.



Reporting & Communication

Submit weekly performance updates including trade summary, equity curve, and forward outlook.

Maintain open, professional communication regarding strategy adjustments and significant market events.

Provide access to live account monitoring dashboard at all times.



POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Track Record

Minimum 6–12 months of verified, consistent profitability.

Verification must be provided via authenticated broker statements.

Applications without a verifiable trading history will not be considered.



Strategy & Methodology

Must be able to clearly articulate the trading methodology used (e.g. price action, smart money concepts, swing trading, algorithmic assistance).

Strategy must have a demonstrable positive expectancy over the verified period.

Pure martingale, grid, or recovery-based strategies are strictly excluded.



Risk Discipline

Absolute commitment to the agreed daily and overall drawdown thresholds.

Demonstrated ability to remain within predefined risk parameters during adverse market conditions.



Psychological Maturity

Ability to handle losing streaks with composure and return to strategy without deviation.

No history of account blow-ups, uncontrolled drawdowns, or significant unexplained losses.



COMPENSATION & TERMS

Component                             

Base Retainer:    

$300 per month, paid regardless of performance

Profit Share:  

10% to Trader|90% to Account Owner paid monthly            

Capital Scaling:   

Starting at $500; scaled significantly upon consistent performance

Working Arrangement:

100% remote. Flexible hours provided risk parameters are respected.





HOW TO APPLY

If you have the discipline and the data to support your trading credentials, please apply by submitting the following:



A brief introduction outlining your trading style, experience, and preferred markets.

A verified track record link or screenshot (MyFxBook preferred; FXBlue or broker statements accepted).

Your profit-share expectations and preferred risk parameters.



Important Notice



Applications without a verifiable track record or references to past performance will not be considered. We value quality over volume and are looking for a long-term professional trading relationship built on trust, discipline, and measurable results.

title: Social Media Content Creator
description:
The Birdhouse Records

Content Creator (Short-Form / Music / House)

Remote · Part-time (?10 hrs/week)



About Birdhouse:

Birdhouse Records is an independent house music label focused on disco, funky, and groove-driven music.

We’re building artists, not just releasing tracks.

That means content isn’t filler, it’s how the music spreads.



The Role:



This is not a posting role.

This is not just video editing.



You are responsible for:

Finding what works

Turning that into ideas

Executing those ideas into content

You will not be filming yourself.



You will be working with:

DJ footage

Artist-submitted clips

Existing online media

Raw assets we provide



Your job is to turn that into content people actually watch.



Responsibilities:



1. Research (this is a big part of the job)

Study artists, labels, and music accounts that are growing

Identify specific posts that are performing well

Break down why they work (hook, format, pacing)

Bring back ideas we can replicate or adapt



2. Concept Development

Turn tracks, moments, or artist stories into content ideas

Create clear concepts before editing (not just “cut clips together”)

Suggest what footage we need from artists when necessary



3. Editing & Execution

Create short-form videos (10–90 seconds)

Use hooks, captions, pacing, and structure that drive retention

Edit using tools like CapCut, Premiere, etc. (nothing overly complex)



4. Content Output

Focus on Instagram first (Reels), with reuse for TikTok/Shorts

Aim for consistent, repeatable formats and not random one-offs

Prioritize engagement and watch time over “polished” visuals



5. Optimization

Pay attention to what performs

Double down on winning formats

Iterate quickly



What We’re Looking For:

You understand house / EDM culture (required)

You’ve created or managed content that gets consistent engagement

Doesn’t need to be viral

But should show ~1k+ views per post consistently

You know what makes someone stop scrolling

You can think in formats and hooks, not just edits

You are proactive and don’t need constant direction

You speak fluent english (accent is okay)



What We Don’t Need:

Someone who only edits clips we hand them

Someone who waits to be told exactly what to do

Someone focused on “cinematic” or overly polished content



If that’s you, this won’t be a fit.



Bonus (Not Required):

Experience working with artists or music brands

Basic understanding of music promotion

DJ/producer background



What Success Looks Like:

Consistent content output every week 

Repeatable content formats that perform

Regular posts hitting 1k–5k+ views, with some scaling higher

Clear improvement over time based on iteration



What You Get:

Direct access to artists and releases

Creative ownership (we expect ideas, not just execution)

Flexible, remote work

Opportunity to grow with the label



How to Apply:



Send:

2–5 examples of content you’ve created

Links to any accounts you’ve managed (if applicable)

A short note on why you’re a fit

Optional (recommended):

2–3 content ideas for a house music release

title: TikTok/Reels Content Research VA + Basic CapCut Editor for AI Image/Video App
description:
# Job Title: TikTok/Reels Content Research VA + Basic CapCut Editor for AI Image/Video App



## About the Project



We are building **Kreo AI**, a new AI image and video generation mobile app.



Kreo AI helps users create AI videos, AI photos, photo-to-video effects, AI dance videos, image edits, and viral social media content.



We are looking for a creative and organized Virtual Assistant who understands TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, AI content, viral trends, and basic short-form editing.



This role will start with a **3-day paid trial**. If the work is strong, this can become a long-term part-time or full-time role.



---



## Main Goal of the Role



Your main job is to help us find viral AI photo/video trends and turn them into content ideas, app template ideas, hooks, captions, and simple short-form videos.



We are looking for someone who can help us build a content system for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



This is not only an admin role. We need someone creative, curious, and interested in AI apps and viral content.



---



## Responsibilities



### 1. TikTok / Reels / Shorts Trend Research



You will research viral content formats related to:



* AI video

* AI image generation

* Photo-to-video

* Image-to-video

* AI dance videos

* AI photo edits

* AI portraits

* AI animation

* Viral filters and effects

* 
-style AI videos

* Creator tools

* Short-form video apps



You will collect useful links and organize them clearly in Google Sheets or Notion.



---



### 2. Content Idea Generation



You will create content ideas for Kreo AI based on viral trends.



Example content ideas:



* “Turn your selfie into this”

* “AI made my photo dance”

* “Photo-to-video AI is getting crazy”

* “3 AI effects you need to try”

* “Normal photo vs AI video result”

* “Which effect should we launch next?”

* “This AI turned my selfie into a movie scene”

* “Would you try this with your photo?”



You should be able to study viral videos and turn them into practical ideas for our app.



---



### 3. AI App Template Ideas



You will suggest new AI image and video template ideas for Kreo AI.



Example template ideas:



* AI Dance

* Photo to Video

* Cinematic Zoom

* Stadium Fan Cam

* AI Headshot

* Anime Portrait

* Fashion Walk

* Couple Effect

* Pet Dance

* Glow-Up Reveal

* AI Movie Poster

* Product Ad Image

* Talking Photo

* Viral 
 Effect

* Fantasy Portrait



---



### 4. Hooks and Captions



You will write short hooks and captions for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.



Example hooks:



* “This AI turned my selfie into a movie scene.”

* “Would you try this with your photo?”

* “AI video apps are getting scary good.”

* “This photo-to-video effect looks unreal.”

* “Which version is better: 1 or 2?”

* “This is what AI can do with one photo.”



Good English is required.



---



### 5. Basic Short-Form Video Editing



You should be able to create simple short-form videos using CapCut, Canva, or similar tools.



Basic editing includes:



* Vertical 9:16 video editing

* Adding text overlays

* Cutting clips

* Adding captions

* Using simple transitions

* Creating before/after videos

* Creating simple thumbnail/cover images

* Exporting TikTok/Reels-ready videos

* Organizing finished content for posting



Advanced editing is not required, but basic CapCut or Canva skill is preferred.



---



### 6. Competitor Research



You will track competitor apps and content.



Examples:



* AI video generator apps

* AI photo editor apps

* Photo-to-video apps

* AI dance apps

* Apps creating viral TikTok/Reels content



You will observe:



* What content they post

* Which videos perform well

* What hooks they use

* What templates/effects they promote

* What ideas Kreo AI should test



---



## Trial Task



Before long-term hiring, selected candidates will complete a **3-day paid trial task**.



The trial task will include:



1. Find 10 viral AI video examples from TikTok/Reels/Shorts

2. Find 10 viral AI photo/image examples

3. Suggest 10 content ideas for Kreo AI

4. Suggest 10 app template ideas

5. Write 10 short hooks/captions

6. Create 1 simple 10–15 second TikTok/Reel sample using CapCut or Canva

7. Submit everything in an organized Google Sheet or document



Please only apply if you are comfortable doing this type of work.



---



## Long-Term Role



If the paid trial is successful, this can become a long-term role.



We may start with:



* 4 hours/day, 5 days/week



Then increase to:



* full-time, 40 hours/week



This depends on performance, quality of work, communication, and reliability.



---



## Daily Tasks After Hiring



If hired long term, your daily tasks may include:



1. Find viral TikTok/Reels/Shorts references

2. Suggest AI video content ideas

3. Suggest AI image/photo content ideas

4. Write hooks and captions

5. Track competitor content

6. Suggest Kreo AI template ideas

7. Create simple edited video drafts

8. Send a daily summary report



---



## Required Skills



* Strong understanding of TikTok and Instagram Reels

title: Junior Bookkeeper – Ironbooks
description:
**Location:** Philippines | **Type:** Full-time Remote



---



## The Vision



We're building the AI-powered bookkeeping service for trades contractors. And we're doing it differently.



Most bookkeeping firms are dinosaurs—slow, expensive, offshore labor treated as a cost center. We're proving the opposite: that the best bookkeepers aren't in expensive US metros. They're smart, hungry, high-D/high-C operators who want to build something real.



**You're not joining a bookkeeping team. You're joining the proof of concept that AI + offshore talent + ruthless execution = the future of accounting operations.**



Every client we onboard. Every book you clean up. Every report you own. That's market validation that traditional accounting firms are about to get disrupted.



---



## What You're Actually Building



This role is ground zero for something bigger:



- **You're the backbone of Ironbooks' operations.** Every client win flows through the work you do. You're not hidden in the back office—your work directly drives revenue, client retention, and company reputation.



- **You're proving a thesis.** We're showing that a Filipino bookkeeper + Claude AI + clear processes = better, faster, cheaper than traditional US-based accounting. That's not a side hustle. That's category-defining.



- **You're scaling a system, not just doing work.** Right now, you're learning. In 6 months, you're training others. In 12 months, you're leading a team and working with our CEO on process improvement. This grows with you.



- **You're part of the Painter Growth ecosystem.** Ironbooks isn't standalone—it's the operational proof point for Painter Growth's AI positioning across the trades. Your work is literally the case study we use to sell coaching and other services. High visibility. Real leverage.



---



## Why This Matters (For You)



**If you're the type who wants more than a job:**



- You'll see direct ROI on your effort. Ship a clean book ? client signs for annual contract ? you see the impact immediately.

- You're not a cost center. You're a revenue driver. That matters differently when you know it.

- You're learning a category-defining skill set: bookkeeping + AI automation + operational systems. That's not replaceable. That's your edge.

- There's a real path here. We're scaling. The people who prove themselves in the first 6 months aren't stuck in junior roles—they move into leadership, specialist tracks, or new ventures as we expand.

- You're working with founders who care about outcomes and speed, not politics. That changes everything about how work feels.



---



## The Reality



We're lean. We move fast. We don't tolerate slow thinking or excuses. But we also:



- Celebrate wins loudly (and mean it)

- Pay attention to people who deliver

- Build in public (you'll see how your work impacts the market)

- Give autonomy to people who earn it

- Actually promote from within



---



## What We Need



**Must-haves:**

- 2+ years of bookkeeping or accounting experience

- Fluent English (writing and speaking)

- Comfortable with QuickBooks Online

- High D energy: you want to win, you move fast, you own your output

- High C discipline: you catch errors, you care about quality, you want to build systems that work

- Openness to AI tools—this is non-negotiable. You'll use Claude, ChatGPT, and automation to multiply your productivity

- Reliable internet and a workspace where you can focus



**Nice-to-haves:**

- Experience with AI tools (you already know how to use them)

- Previous remote work or offshore experience

- Familiarity with Zapier or integration platforms

- Trades or contractor business background



---



## The First 90 Days



- **Month 1:** You're learning our systems, processes, and standards. You're doing deep work on client cleanups and learning to work alongside our AI tools.

- **Month 2:** You're owning client relationships independently. You're proofing your own work, shipping reports, and starting to see patterns in what works.

- **Month 3:** You're refining our processes. You're identifying bottlenecks. You're having ideas about how we do things better. We're listening.



By the end of 90 days, we know if you're the one who grows with us.



---



## Compensation & Benefits



- **Salary:** $7/hr with opportunities for bonuses and raises quickly if demonstrating high quality and great work ethic

- **Hours:** 8 hours/day, PST-aligned (flexible within reason)

- **Tools:** All software, licenses, and AI tools provided

- **Growth trajectory:** Clear progression to senior bookkeeper, operations specialist, or leadership roles

- **Equity conversation:** After 6 months of proving yourself, we talk about how you can own a piece of this upside



---



## Send Us



1. Your resume (focused on results and ROI, not just tasks)

2. 2–3 bookkeeping examples you're genuinely proud of

3. A short note: *Why this role? What does "building something" mean to you? Give us the real answer.*



---



**This isn't a generic bookkeeping job.** We're looking for someone who sees the bigger picture and wants to be part of proving that offshore + AI + execution = the future of accounting.



If that's you, let's talk.

title: Virtual Frond Desk

# Virtual Front Desk — Refine Med Spa

**Remote (Philippines-based) · Full-time · US Mountain Time hours**



## About Refine Med Spa

Refine Med Spa is building Denver's premier network of medical aesthetics practices — injectables, laser, and advanced skincare — under one operating platform. As we grow our portfolio of owned locations across the Denver metro, we're centralizing the patient experience so every clinic delivers the same fast, professional, on-brand front-desk service.



We're a remote-first, results-driven team. We move fast, we measure what matters, and we free our providers to do their best clinical work by taking the front-desk load off their plate.



## The Role

Our injectors and clinical staff are at their best with a patient in the chair — not chasing voi
s. Missed calls and slow lead follow-up are lost revenue. As a **Virtual Front Desk (VFD)**, you're the first voice and first responder for Refine Med Spa: answering calls and messages, converting inbound leads into booked appointments, and keeping calendars full and accurate.



This is a high-impact, revenue-facing role. In medical aesthetics, speed-to-lead and booking conversion directly drive the business — and you own them.



## What You'll Do

- Answer inbound phone calls, texts, and messages for 4–5 Refine locations promptly and professionally

- **Convert inbound leads into booked consultations and treatments** by calling and texting through our CRM — speed-to-lead is everything

- Book, confirm, reschedule, and manage appointments across multiple location calendars

- Reduce no-shows through proactive confirmation and reminder workflows

- Answer routine questions (location, hours, services, basic pricing, pre/post-care logistics)

- Capture accurate patient and lead information in our CRM/EMR

- Escalate clinical questions and anything outside your scope to the location owner/manager

- Hit defined targets: response time, lead-to-booking conversion, confirmation rate, no-show rate



## What We're Looking For

- 2+ years in a customer-service-facing role — Virtual Assistant, front desk, contact center, or similar

- **Healthcare, medical, dental, or aesthetics background strongly preferred** — you understand patient sensitivity and confidentiality

- **Proven sales or lead-conversion experience** — you can move a hesitant inbound lead to a booked appointment without being pushy

- Clear, neutral English — spoken and written. Phone presence matters.

- Availability during **US Mountain Time** business hours, following the **US holiday calendar**

- Independent, accountable problem-solver who performs with minimal supervision

- Reliable home office: fast wired internet, **backup connection and power**, quiet environment, quality headset



## Nice to Have

- Experience with med spa / aesthetics CRMs and EMRs

- Familiarity with **GoHighLevel**

- Prior remote work supporting a US healthcare or services company



## Compliance & Confidentiality

This role handles **protected health information (PHI)**. You will complete HIPAA training and sign a confidentiality agreement before touching any patient data. Strict adherence to our data-handling, privacy, and access protocols is a condition of employment.



## Logistics

- Full-time, fully remote (Philippines-based)

- US Mountain Time business hours; US holiday schedule

- Compensation: **$5/hr - $7/hr**



## How to Apply

Please submit:

1. **A 2-minute (max) video or voice sample** — introduce yourself, then imagine greeting a patient calling to ask about a Botox consultation

2. **Your resume**

3. **An internet speed-test screenshot**



---



*At Refine, we hire owners. We give more than we take, we move with urgency and care, and we treat every patient interaction as the front door to our business.*

Your mission? Make sure every approved post reflects campaign requirements, avoids spam or cheating, and feels aligned with the creator's niche. You’ll get trained on specific campaign types (like music, clipping, or logo posts), and will review content against clearly defined SOPs.



This is part quality assurance, part community trust, and fully essential to the creator experience on Clipster.

- Carefully review creator submissions to ensure they meet campaign requirements.

- Identify and reject content with low effort, misaligned themes, or inorganic engagement.

- Use internal tools like Notion, CreatorCore, and Google Sheets to track and update approvals.

- Flag suspicious or borderline content using the “Flagged” system for internal review.

- Provide clear, concise rejection notes when content doesn’t meet standards.

- Collaborate with other reviewers and escalate when in doubt.

- Be available for weekend shifts and flexible hours, as campaign needs evolve.



Job Details:



Type: Hourly contract ($3/hour, paid bi-weekly).

Hours: Flexible, with some availability needed on weekends.

Tracking: We use Hubstaff for time tracking.

Tools: Notion, Slack, 
, Gather, CreatorCore.

What We’re Looking For:



- Excellent written English and attention to detail.

- A methodical approach, someone who doesn’t rush, but reviews with care.

- Availability to work independently and make confident decisions.

- A willingness to follow (and improve!) approval SOPs.

- Comfort using Notion, 
, Slack, and collaborative tools.

- Open to feedback, learning, and adapting to very fast-evolving campaign needs.



Bonus Points If…



- You’ve worked in content moderation, creator platforms, or QA roles.

- You enjoy checking small details and spotting inconsistencies.

- You’ve worked with digital creators, streamers, or niche online communities.

- You’re a fan of anime, gaming, sports, or other creator niches we support.



Why Clipster?



Clipster is already trusted by thousands of creators, from anime editors to esports content creators, helping them earn from their passion.



By joining our Content Approvals Team, you play a direct role in preserving campaign integrity, maintaining creator trust, and shaping the quality bar across our platform.

title: In CEBU - High-End Film Editor / On-Set Assistant Editor / DIT
description:
Location: Cebu, Philippines

Production Dates: June 22 – July 4

Position Type: On-set / Local hire / Project-based

Software Required: Final Cut Pro X and DaVinci Resolve

Fil-Am Films is looking for a reliable, detail-oriented, high-end film editor who can work with us directly on set in Cebu during production.



This is not a remote-only post-production job. We need someone physically present with the production team, or close to base camp, every filming day to organize footage, sync audio, prepare timelines, and assemble scenes daily so the director can review the footage during the shoot.

We are looking for someone who can support the movie during production and potentially edit the full feature film after the shoot.



Main Responsibilities

Be available in Cebu for all required shoot days from June 22 through July 4

Receive footage from camera and sound departments daily

Organize, label, and back up all footage properly

Sync audio and video

Prepare timelines/sequences in Final Cut Pro X and/or DaVinci Resolve

Assemble rough scenes from the previous day’s footage

Deliver daily reviewable scene assemblies/dailies for the director

Flag any missing shots, technical issues, continuity problems, or unusable footage as early as possible

Maintain clean project files and organized drive structure

Assist with exports, backups, and handoff to the main post-production workflow

Potentially continue after production as the full feature film editor



Important Expectation

The purpose of this role is to help us review the movie while we are still filming. We need to see assembled scenes or dailies during production, not only after the shoot is finished.

If a scene has technical issues, missing coverage, audio problems, or performance concerns, we need to know while we still have the cast, crew, and location available.



Required Skills

Strong experience editing narrative films, trailers, or cinematic content

Must know Final Cut Pro X

Must know DaVinci Resolve

Experience syncing audio and video

Experience organizing large amounts of footage

Ability to create rough scene assemblies quickly

Strong attention to detail

Reliable attendance and punctuality

Ability to work under production pressure

Good communication with director and production team



Preferred Skills

Feature film editing experience

DIT / data wrangling experience

Color grading experience

Sound cleanup experience

Trailer editing experience

Ability to continue as full editor after production



Schedule Requirement

You must be available in Cebu during the production dates. This role requires daily presence or immediate availability near base camp.

Please do not apply if you are only available remotely or if you cannot commit to the production schedule.



To Apply

Please send:

Your editing reel or sample scenes

Feature film or narrative work examples

Your experience with Final Cut Pro X and DaVinci Resolve

Your daily rate or project rate

Confirmation that you are available in Cebu from June 22 through July 4

Confirmation that you understand this role requires daily footage organization, syncing, and rough scene assemblies during production





We are looking for someone dependable, fast, organized, and creative who can grow with our film slate.
